headline: Mstc Limited announces a change in its board of directors
hook: Leadership shift at state-run metals firm
summary: Mstc Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a change in its board of directors. The company's regulatory filing outlines the departure or appointment of directorial personnel. Board shuffles in public sector enterprises generally do not impact day-to-day operations immediately.
